name: Thesis Polish
description:
Thesis-polish helps Chinese undergraduate students improve the naturalness and readability of their academic writing. It rewrites AI-assisted
or mechanically-written thesis drafts into more authentic, human-sounding academic prose while strictly preserving professional terminology,
data, citations, and original meaning. The skill applies eight core strategies including adding natural filler words, replacing mechanical
transition phrases, varying sentence rhythm, and breaking overly-perfect parallel structures that are characteristic of AI-generated text
longDescription:
